name: Luna Sonata
source:
On a same old day, same old job as a Hunter, I've been attacked by a vampire! As my peaceful life was falling apart, I came across an opportunity of a lifetime.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.lunasonata.otome.vampire.story.bloodline]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在同一天，同样的猎人工作，我被吸血鬼袭击了！当我平静的生活崩溃时，我遇到了一个千载难逢的机会。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.lunasonata.otome.vampire.story.bloodline]Google Play[/url]]
